capabilities.name: Research environment lifecycle
capabilities.ownershipNotes: TICKET_1335 D2 and TICKET_1355: Electron and Guide MCP are thin adapters over the shared ResearchEnvironmentService. Install, repair, and whole-environment uninstall use the same durable lifecycle; mutation authority requires native human approval and uninstall additionally fails closed unless workload activity is authoritatively idle. Individual package removal is intentionally not exposed because pixi.toml and pixi.lock are the repository-owned dependency definition.

capabilities.name: Signal promotion / roster admission
capabilities.ownershipNotes: Persisted promotion status is Class-S; live admission and go-live transitions are Class-R.

capabilities.name: Relegation config/cycle
capabilities.ownershipNotes: Relegation configuration is Class-S; executing a relegation cycle is Class-R.

capabilities.name: LSTM training runs
capabilities.ownershipNotes: Training history is Class-S; start, status, retry, and cancellation coordinate a Class-R trainer.
